title: World c. AD 1300

source.name: Cliopatria
source.author: Seshat Global History Databank
source.citation: Bennett et al. (2025), Cliopatria, Scientific Data. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-025-04516-9
source.changes: POLITY records active in AD 1300, inclusive dates; relations excluded; sorted by area; coordinates quantized to 0.0001 degrees; parent realm names annotated. No historical corrections applied.

note: Approximate recorded polity extents, including overlapping realms and their members. Plain land does not imply uninhabited or unclaimed land. Modern coastlines are used as context.
